title: 10/10 for free users
body: What I love is that all of the relevant features are completely free, super smooth, with a very pretty UI. It’s incredibly good at multi-tracking many things whether it’s to stop alcohol or just manage a tolerance break. And the incentives to have users spend money is far less than in similar apps. I’ve had a great time with it and recommend it to others. I can also praise that the subscription plans are long lasting and affordable for those in difficult situations. Major respect.
